assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire collects legal marital status (ECIV1: Soltero, Casado, Viudo, Separado o divorciado), presence/absence of a partner in the household (NCONY), and reasons for temporary or prolonged absence of members (DR1-DR3), which allows distinguishing de jure unpartnered women from de facto unpartnered women whose spouse is absent (de_jure_vs_de_facto: true). In Section A Q5, explicit pointer variables identify each individual's mother (NMADRE), father (NPADRE), and spouse/partner (NCONY), allowing unpartnered mother-child units to be identified within any household configuration (unpartnered_mother_child_units: true). The questionnaire does not collect household income or identify the main economic provider of the household (women_maintained_by_provider: false), nor does it collect consumption, hearth-hold production, or care activity linked directly to the mother-child unit (mother_child_unit_activity: false).
